note: Ship 10 — Custom Rule Builder. A safe, hand-written recursive-descent parser + evaluator for user-defined signal rules. No eval(). Users write rules like `crossed_above(ema8, ema24)` or `rsi < 30 and macdHist > macdHist[1]` — matching rules fire into reasons AND into the Watch synthesis when their action is WATCH BUY / WATCH SELL. Eight preset rules ship enabled=false (Golden cross, Death cross, MACD-signal crosses, MACD-H zero-line crosses, deep-oversold + bottoming, deep-overbought + topping). New Custom Rules sidebar section with list/add/edit/delete/toggle/test. Full grammar reference at docs/library/CUSTOM_RULES_GUIDE.md. Kirk's three decades finally have a home in the tool.
